hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | xargs -I{} sh -c 'echo "{}" | grep -qE "\.(ts|tsx|json|md|css|html)$" && npx prettier --write "{}" 2>/dev/null; true'
jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | grep -qE '^git commit' && { cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && npm run tsc && npm run lint && npm run test -- run; } || true
